entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Agent' at any time to speak with a representative.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
My VeloBand is broken. I need to start a return.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number please?
Alex Chen. Order number is VF-881-92B. Just tell me yes or no, can I return it?

Okay, Mr. Chen, I'm pulling that up now... I see you ordered the new VeloBand GPS Tracker. I also see you're one of our VIP members, thank you for your loyalty. What seems to be the specific issue with the device?
The heart rate sensor is not working at all. It won't sync the data, and my workout logs are useless without it. The thing is defective.
I understand your frustration. A tracker that doesn't track is certainly not helpful. Let me just confirm the delivery date... It looks like it was delivered 22 days ago.
Right. So, can you process the return?
Absolutely. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. Since you're reporting the item as defective, I will process that for you immediately.

I've just approved the return. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Simply pack the defective band in its original box and use that label. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. As a VIP, I've also made sure the refund will be processed the same day it arrives at our warehouse.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist with today, Mr. Chen?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
